conclusions: Guest translation caches need not equal the current paging-structure bytes.
Processors may discard cached translations at any time.
Delayed invalidation permits old or new translations; this is not an observed native-HVF mismatch.
open_probes: Native HVF cache retention after an MMIO exit/completion and between host slices.
Supported managed-writer interleaving or a single-guest delayed-invalidation stream producing mismatched exit GPA.
Host SDK invalidation guarantees and safe retry behavior if a genuine mismatch is observed.
